## Bitta Blues

Bitta Blues is a *fan-named* Earth-pony mare glimpsed among Ponyville's townsponies during Cheese Sandwich's “The Super Duper Party Pony” number in *Pinkie Pride* (season 4, episode 12). Look for a blue-gray coat, violet mane and tail, vivid magenta eyes, and a red-and-black ladybug cutie mark. She shares a stock character design with Berryshine, Cherry Berry, and Berry Dreams, so her colors and ladybug are the useful identifiers.

[![Bitta Blues in Pinkie Pride — Hasbro Studios/DHX Media production still](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/mlp/images/9/96/Bitta_Blues_ID_S4E12.png/revision/latest?cb=20140204033602)](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Earth_ponies/Mares)

- *Name:* “Bitta Blues” is a viewer-assigned/wiki placeholder, not a verified spoken or Hasbro-given name; the [fan-name record](https://mlp.fandom.com/ru/wiki/%D0%A1%D0%BF%D0%B8%D1%81%D0%BE%D0%BA_%D0%BF%D0%BE%D0%BD%D0%B8) explicitly describes it as viewer-given. Hasbro sold a different, green ladybug-marked pony as [Bitta Luck](https://www.strawberryreef.com/Index/Name/bittaluckFIMmini.html); their similar names and marks do not establish that they are the same character. The exact origin of “Bitta Blues” is unverified.
- *Speaking and appearances:* One documented TV appearance, in *Pinkie Pride*; no identifiable spoken dialogue or credited voice actor. No independently verified disguise, alter ego, or additional appearances.
- *Fan artwork:* [![Sketches featuring Bitta Blues, credited to Jakusi](https://ponerpics.org/img/2025/7/13/7281234/full.jpg)](https://ponerpics.org/images/7281234) — Jakusi's multi-character sketches from the Derpy Doodles panel at /mlp/con 2025.

## Important moments

1. *A face in Cheese Sandwich's party parade* — *Pinkie Pride* (S4E12): Bitta Blues appears briefly during “The Super Duper Party Pony,” identifying her as one of the townsponies caught up in the spectacular party pitch. Watch the [verified full episode on the official My Little Pony channel](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=95R4diMuWOU); an exact timestamp in this upload could not be confirmed.

Only this one attributable scene is documented; inventing a second character-defining moment would misrepresent a background extra.
